title: Code Story story file
description: Schema version 1. Stories are UTF-8, pretty-printed in this field order, at most 256 KB, and saved as .codestory/local/<yyyy-MM-dd>-<slug>.story.json at the repository root. The plugin assigns creation metadata, missing step IDs and the stored code of each range, and it writes the comment threads.

id.description: The file name without .story.json. A number suffix keeps IDs unique across local and shared stories.

title.description: The story title: 8 words or fewer.

type.description: The kind of story, supplied by the agent.

summary.description: A summary in 1 to 3 short sentences, supplied by the agent.

request.description: The original Code Story request text, supplied by the agent.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 creation time, assigned by the plugin.

baseRef.description: Only for a story about a change, supplied by the agent: the commit before the change, or HEAD for uncommitted work. The plugin saves the full SHA of the commit when Git knows it, and shows the lines that each step added or modified since then. Omit it or use null for other stories.

delivery.description: Plugin-owned MCP delivery marker. Other IDEs list the story but never auto-play it. Omit this field for file-drop delivery.

steps.description: Steps in reading order: 3 to 12 are best, 15 at most.

threads.description: Comment threads about the whole story, written by the plugin. Agents never set them, and a revision keeps them. Omitted when there are none.

model.description: The model that wrote the story.

git.description: Git state at creation, assigned by the plugin. Null fields indicate unavailable Git, an unborn branch or detached HEAD.

id.description: Stable and unique within the story. The agent may omit it in code_story_show; the plugin assigns one and saves it. Keep it on revisions.

kind.description: What the step does for the reader. explanation (the default, omitted in saved files) explains code, or introduces or closes the story. context gives background for the nearest earlier step that is not context, for example a method that it calls; context before the first such step is background for the whole story. proposal suggests a change that the agent did not make.

title.description: The step title: 8 words or fewer.

comment.description: One idea in 1 to 3 sentences, or one lead sentence and up to 4 bullet items; 60 words at most. Instructions have at most 20 words per sentence, descriptions 25. These writing limits produce agent warnings only. Text-only steps can introduce the subject or list what to check.

location.description: Exactly one location or none. Omit it or use null for a text-only step. For a proposal, the lines that the proposal changes.

proposedCode.description: Only for a proposal step: the code that replaces the lines of the location, with \n between lines; an empty text proposes to remove them. Without a location, it is new code. The plugin removes a final line break.

children.description: Reserved for later modes; ignored in v1.

links.description: Reserved for later modes; ignored in v1.

threads.description: Comment threads about this step, written by the plugin. A revision keeps them by step ID. Omitted when there are none.

location.description: One range of lines in one file.

file.description: Repository-relative path with / between folders. No absolute paths or .. segments.

endLine.description: Last line, 1-based and inclusive; not smaller than startLine.

anchorText.description: The exact text of line startLine, as the agent sends it. Comparisons ignore leading and trailing whitespace and line endings. The plugin checks it on arrival, uses it to find the range again after the code moves, and follows it when the reader edits that line.

rangeText.description: The code of the range that the step explains, with \n between lines. The plugin sets it when the step arrives and compares it with the current code to mark steps whose code changed. Agents do not set it.

thread.description: A reader comment and the replies to it. Rounds are numbered per story.

id.description: Unique within the story, assigned by the plugin.

kind.description: question, change (a request to change the code) or refresh (a request to update steps whose code changed).

state.description: submitted (waits for an agent; the reader can withdraw it), received (an agent fetched it), answered, done, declined, or resolved (closed by the reader). A new reader comment sets it to submitted again.

removedStep.description: The title of the step that the thread was about, when a revision removed that step. The thread is then on the story.

messages.description: Reader comments and agent replies, oldest first.

storyBaseline.description: Plugin-owned step fingerprints from the first story edit for a received comment. Used across restarts to calculate net story changes; cleared after the reply.

pendingStoryChanges.description: Plugin-owned summary of author revisions since the first edit for this received comment. Copied to the agent reply and cleared after the reply.

stepsToSync.description: Plugin-owned stale step IDs that still need review after feedback was fetched. Cleared as steps are updated, replaced or confirmed.

confirmedSteps.description: Plugin-owned IDs explicitly confirmed while the comment was received; used for the Story changes summary.

previousKind.description: Plugin-owned prior thread kind, restored when an unfetched follow-up is withdrawn. Cleared when fetched.

round.description: The round of the reader comment that the message belongs to.

outcome.description: Agent replies only: answered for a question, done for a change or refresh request, or declined with a reason.

text.description: Markdown subset. Reader comments are not checked; agent replies follow the writing rules.

storyChanges.description: Agent replies only. Automatic summary of story edits made while the comment was received, computed by the plugin. Displayed as Story changes; agents cannot set it.

changedFiles.description: Agent-reported repository-relative changed code paths. Present on done replies; an empty list means no code files changed.
